data.one_liner: Restarts a Flutter app by recreating the engine at runtime.
data.what_it_does: The plugin creates a new FlutterEngine instance and re‑executes the Dart entry point, effectively restarting the app without closing the native host. It works on Android and iOS via activity or view controller recreation.
use_when: You need to programmatically restart the app (e.g., after a language change or critical config update)
You want a quick way to reset app state without manual navigation tricks
avoid_when: You require a full native app restart (process kill)
You need a solution that works on web, desktop, or other platforms not listed
strengths: No native code changes required on Android
weaknesses: May not work with all plugin lifecycles
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency and, for iOS, insert a few lines in AppDelegate.swift to re‑register plugins; no permissions needed.
